001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007import java.util.Set;
008
009/**
010 * FreeStyle Libre 3 CGM data sample. Same layout as {@link CgmDataFsl2HistoryLog}.
011 */
012@HistoryLogProps(
013    opCode = 480,
014    displayName = "CGM Data (FSL3)",
015    internalName = "LID_CGM_DATA_FSL3"
016)
017public class CgmDataFsl3HistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
018
019    private int glucoseValueStatusRaw;
020    private int cgmDataTypeRaw;
021    private int rate;
022    private int algorithmStateRaw;
023    private int rssi;
024    private int currentGlucoseDisplayValue;
025    private long egvTimestamp;
026    private int egvInfoBitmaskRaw;
027    private int interval;
028
029    public CgmDataFsl3HistoryLog() {}
030    public CgmDataFsl3HistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum) {
031        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
032    }
033
034    public CgmDataFsl3HistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int glucoseValueStatusRaw, int cgmDataTypeRaw, int rate, int algorithmStateRaw, int rssi, int currentGlucoseDisplayValue, long egvTimestamp, int egvInfoBitmaskRaw, int interval) {
035        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
036        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, glucoseValueStatusRaw, cgmDataTypeRaw, rate, algorithmStateRaw, rssi, currentGlucoseDisplayValue, egvTimestamp, egvInfoBitmaskRaw, interval);
037        parse(cargo);
038    }
039
040    public CgmDataFsl3HistoryLog(int glucoseValueStatusRaw, int cgmDataTypeRaw, int rate, int algorithmStateRaw, int rssi, int currentGlucoseDisplayValue, long egvTimestamp, int egvInfoBitmaskRaw, int interval) {
041        this(0, 0, glucoseValueStatusRaw, cgmDataTypeRaw, rate, algorithmStateRaw, rssi, currentGlucoseDisplayValue, egvTimestamp, egvInfoBitmaskRaw, interval);
042    }
043
044    public int typeId() {
045        return 480;
046    }
047
048    /**
049     * <table border="1">
050     * <caption>Parsed fields for CgmDataFsl3HistoryLog:</caption>
051     * <tr><td><code>glucoseValueStatusRaw</code></td><td><code>raw[10] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
052     * <tr><td><code>cgmDataTypeRaw</code></td><td><code>raw[11] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
053     * <tr><td><code>rate</code></td><td><code>(short) Bytes.readShort(raw, 12)</code></td></tr>
054     * <tr><td><code>algorithmStateRaw</code></td><td><code>raw[14] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
055     * <tr><td><code>rssi</code></td><td><code>raw[15]</code></td></tr>
056     * <tr><td><code>currentGlucoseDisplayValue</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 16)</code></td></tr>
057     * <tr><td><code>egvTimestamp</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
058     * <tr><td><code>egvInfoBitmaskRaw</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
059     * <tr><td><code>interval</code></td><td><code>raw[24] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
060     * </table>
061     */
062    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
063        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
064        this.cargo = raw;
065        parseBase(raw);
066        this.glucoseValueStatusRaw = raw[10] & 0xFF;
067        this.cgmDataTypeRaw = raw[11] & 0xFF;
068        this.rate = (short) Bytes.readShort(raw, 12);
069        this.algorithmStateRaw = raw[14] & 0xFF;
070        this.rssi = raw[15];
071        this.currentGlucoseDisplayValue = Bytes.readShort(raw, 16);
072        this.egvTimestamp = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18);
073        this.egvInfoBitmaskRaw = Bytes.readShort(raw, 22);
074        this.interval = raw[24] & 0xFF;
075    }
076
077    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum) {
078        return buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
079    }
080
081    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int glucoseValueStatusRaw, int cgmDataTypeRaw, int rate, int algorithmStateRaw, int rssi, int currentGlucoseDisplayValue, long egvTimestamp, int egvInfoBitmaskRaw, int interval) {
082        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
083            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(480, 0), // 480 = 0x01E0
084            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
085            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
086            new byte[]{(byte) glucoseValueStatusRaw},
087            new byte[]{(byte) cgmDataTypeRaw},
088            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(rate & 0xFFFF),
089            new byte[]{(byte) algorithmStateRaw},
090            new byte[]{(byte) rssi},
091            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(currentGlucoseDisplayValue),
092            Bytes.toUint32(egvTimestamp),
093            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(egvInfoBitmaskRaw),
094            new byte[]{(byte) interval},
095            new byte[]{0}));
096    }
097
098    public int getGlucoseValueStatusRaw() {
099        return glucoseValueStatusRaw;
100    }
101    public CgmDataFsl2HistoryLog.GlucoseValueStatus getGlucoseValueStatus() {
102        return CgmDataFsl2HistoryLog.GlucoseValueStatus.fromId(glucoseValueStatusRaw);
103    }
104    public int getCgmDataTypeRaw() {
105        return cgmDataTypeRaw;
106    }
107    public Set<CgmDataFsl2HistoryLog.CgmDataType> getCgmDataType() {
108        return CgmDataFsl2HistoryLog.CgmDataType.fromId(cgmDataTypeRaw);
109    }
110    /**
111     * Signed rate of change, in mg/dL per minute.
112     */
113    public int getRate() {
114        return rate;
115    }
116    public int getAlgorithmStateRaw() {
117        return algorithmStateRaw;
118    }
119    public CgmDataFsl2HistoryLog.AlgorithmState getAlgorithmState() {
120        return CgmDataFsl2HistoryLog.AlgorithmState.fromId(algorithmStateRaw);
121    }
122    /**
123     * Signed RSSI, in dBm.
124     */
125    public int getRssi() {
126        return rssi;
127    }
128    /**
129     * @return the glucose value in mg/dL
130     */
131    public int getCurrentGlucoseDisplayValue() {
132        return currentGlucoseDisplayValue;
133    }
134    public long getEgvTimestamp() {
135        return egvTimestamp;
136    }
137    public int getEgvInfoBitmaskRaw() {
138        return egvInfoBitmaskRaw;
139    }
140    public Set<CgmDataFsl2HistoryLog.EgvInfo> getEgvInfo() {
141        return CgmDataFsl2HistoryLog.EgvInfo.fromId(egvInfoBitmaskRaw);
142    }
143    /**
144     * @return the sensor type encoded in bits 11-13 of the EGV info bitmask (2 = Libre 2, 4 = Libre 3)
145     */
146    public int getSensorType() {
147        return (egvInfoBitmaskRaw >> 11) & 0x7;
148    }
149    public int getInterval() {
150        return interval;
151    }
152
153    /** @deprecated use {@link #getGlucoseValueStatusRaw()} */
154    @Deprecated
155    public int getStatus() {
156        return glucoseValueStatusRaw;
157    }
158    /** @deprecated use {@link #getCgmDataTypeRaw()} */
159    @Deprecated
160    public int getType() {
161        return cgmDataTypeRaw;
162    }
163    /** @deprecated use {@link #getCurrentGlucoseDisplayValue()} */
164    @Deprecated
165    public int getValue() {
166        return currentGlucoseDisplayValue;
167    }
168    /** @deprecated use {@link #getEgvTimestamp()} */
169    @Deprecated
170    public long getTimestamp() {
171        return egvTimestamp;
172    }
173}
